context: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Total doses used in captive minor species hoof stock to date have ranged from 1 mg (Impala) to 15 mg (African elephant). Immobilization is usually achieved in 2 to 10 minutes following administration. The most effective dose rate will vary
